changes: Added the GetDHCompenMode() interface for getting the robot DH compensation model;
Added the GetDHAllParam() interface for getting robot DH2.0 parameters (d, a, alpha, beta, theta);

Modified the WeaveSetPara() interface for setting weaving parameters to add weavePendulumLength (pendulum length) and weavePendulumAngle (pendulum angle), default 0; when pendulum weaving is not used, the original 14 parameters are still sent for compatibility with older controllers;
Added the SetCartOffsetRT() interface for setting real-time motion offset, sent as an 8080 command frame (cmdID 1368) with low latency;

Added welding parameter interfaces SetWeldType(), SetWeldCompany(), SetWeldWFS(), SetWeldArcLen(), SetWeldArcCtrl(), SetWeldSlot(), SetWeldDisable(), and UDP custom control word configuration interfaces SetweldWFSUdpNum(), SetWeldArcLenUdpNum(), SetWeldArcCtrlUdpNum(), SetWeldSlotUdpNum(), SetWeldDisableExtDoNum(), SetWeldSynStateExtDINum();

Added welding status feedback interfaces GetWeldSynState() for the synergy state and GetWeldWfsFeedback() for the actual wire feed speed, plus the status word configuration SetWeldWfsFeedbackUdpNum();

Added end-effector suction cup interfaces SetAxleSuckerFunc(), GetAxleSuckerFunc(), SetAxleSuckerCtrl(), SetAxleSuckerAct(), GetAxleSuckerState() and WaitAxleSuckerState(); the suction cup function code adds Bit11 (channel 1 control enable) and Bit12 (channel 2 control enable);
Modified SetAxleLuaEnableDeviceType(), GetAxleLuaEnableDeviceType() and GetAxleLuaEnableDevice() to add the end-effector suction cup enable item;
